title: Beef and chickpea stew
summary: Beef and chickpea stew is a middle eastern dinner built around lean stewing beef and canned chickpeas in water, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Beef and chickpea stew. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add lean stewing beef and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned chickpeas in water.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Beef and chickpea stew before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Beef and chickpea stew.
